-- What a client importing `Proof.go_etcd_io.raft.v3.TraceSimEnd` sees of it (generated by etc/gen-interface.py; do not edit).
-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

theorem TraceSim.trace_agree_keep (γt : GName) (L1 L2 : List TraceEv) : traceAuth γt L1 ∗ traceFrag
    γt L2 ⊢ (traceAuth γt L1 ∗ traceFrag γt L2) ∗ ⌜L1 = L2⌝

theorem TraceSim.newTrace_simInit (C : List w64) (L : List TraceEv) (σ : Etcdraft.State) (hC0 : C ≠
    []) (hCl : C.length < 2 ^ 40) (hrun : TraceSim.SimRun C L σ) (hev : TraceSim.SimEvents C.length
    L) (hseg : TraceSim.BootSegs C L) (hdone : ∀ (i : w64), i ∈ C → TraceSim.BootDone C L i) : ∃ t,
    Etcdraft.newTrace (List.map TraceSim.evConv L) = Except.ok t ∧ t.server = TraceSim.confAbs C ∧
    t.initSrv = TraceSim.confAbs C ∧ t.init = TraceSim.simInit C

theorem TraceSim.simInv_end (C : List w64) (tn : TraceSim.TraceNames) (Fx : Etcdraft.State → IProp
    GF) (L : List TraceEv) : traceAuth tn.tr L ∗ TraceSim.simInv C tn Fx ⊢ traceAuth tn.tr L ∗
    TraceSim.simInv C tn Fx ∗ ⌜∃ σ, TraceSim.SimRun C L σ ∧ σ.server = TraceSim.confAbs C ∧
    TraceSim.SimEvents C.length L⌝

theorem TraceSim.simRun_runAccepted (C : List w64) (L : List TraceEv) (σ : Etcdraft.State) (t :
    Etcdraft.Trace) (hrun : TraceSim.SimRun C L σ) (hnt : Etcdraft.newTrace (List.map
    TraceSim.evConv L) = Except.ok t) (hinit : t.init = TraceSim.simInit C) (hsrv : t.server =
    TraceSim.confAbs C) (hisrv : t.initSrv = TraceSim.confAbs C) : ∃ t ts, Etcdraft.newTrace
    (List.map TraceSim.evConv L) = Except.ok t ∧ t.RunRel t.len ts

theorem TraceSim.simRun_runRel (C : List w64) (L : List TraceEv) (σ : Etcdraft.State) (t :
    Etcdraft.Trace) : TraceSim.SimRun C L σ → Etcdraft.newTrace (List.map TraceSim.evConv L) =
    Except.ok t → t.init = TraceSim.simInit C → t.server = TraceSim.confAbs C → t.initSrv =
    TraceSim.confAbs C → ∃ ts, t.RunRel t.len ts

theorem TraceSim.bootDone_mem_keep (tn : TraceSim.TraceNames) (Dn : List w64) (i : w64) :
    monoListAuthOwn tn.dn 1 Dn ∗ TraceSim.bootDone tn i ⊢ (monoListAuthOwn tn.dn 1 Dn ∗
    TraceSim.bootDone tn i) ∗ ⌜i ∈ Dn⌝

theorem TraceSim.bootDones_mem (tn : TraceSim.TraceNames) (Dn C : List w64) : (monoListAuthOwn tn.dn
    1 Dn ∗ [∗list] i ∈ C, TraceSim.bootDone tn i) ⊢ monoListAuthOwn tn.dn 1 Dn ∗ ⌜∀ (i : w64), i ∈ C
    → i ∈ Dn⌝

theorem TraceSim.simInv_end_bootDone (C : List w64) (tn : TraceSim.TraceNames) (Fx : Etcdraft.State
    → IProp GF) (L : List TraceEv) (hC0 : C ≠ []) (hCl : C.length < 2 ^ 40) : (traceAuth tn.tr L ∗
    TraceSim.simInv C tn Fx ∗ [∗list] i ∈ C, TraceSim.bootDone tn i) ⊢ traceAuth tn.tr L ∗
    TraceSim.simInv C tn Fx ∗ ⌜∃ t, Etcdraft.newTrace (List.map TraceSim.evConv L) = Except.ok t ∧
    t.init = TraceSim.simInit C ∧ t.server = TraceSim.confAbs C ∧ t.initSrv = TraceSim.confAbs C⌝
